hints.title: Two-Pass Length Counting Elimination Obstacle
hints.text: Traversing once to count and once to find the middle is redundant. How can two runners moving at different speeds pinpoint the exact midpoint in a single pass?

hints.title: 2x Speed Tortoise-and-Hare Invariant
hints.text: When fast moves two nodes for every one node slow moves, slow reaches the exact midpoint the moment fast reaches the end.

hints.title: Single-Pass Midpoint Step Procedure
hints.text: Initialize slow and fast at head. While fast and fast.next are not null, advance slow by one and fast by two. Return slow.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in list (1 <= N <= 100)
complexity.notes: Fast and slow pointer single pass finding the second middle node on even lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting nodes first requires two passes across memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fast/slow pointers locate the midpoint in a single pass in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Knowing the condition while fast and fast.next correctly targets the second middle node.
